_about: Skill trees on Durango's 1-60 scale (specs 03/09/11/12 + systems PRD §7). Every tree starts at Lv. 1; auto nodes are learned free once their level is reached. status: functional = the game enforces the effect, partial = the value exists but no system reads it yet, defined = data only. source: spec09/11/12 = Durango pack, prd7 = our PRD. sp_assumed / level_assumed = the pack gives no SP / level, ours is a placeholder. A tree level cannot exceed the character level except levels granted by the occupation (ASSUMPTION).

named_only._about: Spec 12:162 names Surviving Durango I-VII as Survival category milestones but gives no level, SP or effect, so they are recorded here and not placed in the tree. Spec 12:115 also mentions an instrument-making line with no node names.
